Thanks, Kelly. That’s helpful.

 

Since this individual will be using their personal vehicle for regular TidalHealth business each week, I want to make sure we have all of the requirements clearly defined before we post the position.

 

A few additional questions:

  • Are there minimum personal auto insurance coverage limits we need to require?
  • Will we need to collect proof of insurance at hire and periodically thereafter?
  • Does the employee need to confirm with their carrier that their policy covers regular business use of the vehicle?
  • Will TidalHealth conduct a driving-record/MVR check for this position?
  • If an accident occurs while the employee is performing TidalHealth business, does TidalHealth provide any secondary or excess coverage after the employee’s personal insurance?
  • Is the employee responsible for any deductible or damage to their personal vehicle?
  • Would mileage be reimbursed for the regular courier routes?
  • Should we revise the job description language that currently states the employee must be “insurable under TidalHealth’s automobile insurance plan” if they will be driving their personal vehicle?

 

Marisa/Erin, I’d also like to better understand the standby designation. We anticipate needing this person on a regular schedule two days per week to run established routes. Does standby allow us to schedule someone consistently in that manner, or would another classification be more appropriate?

 

I just want to make sure we have the employment classification, insurance requirements and expectations for the candidate clearly defined before we move forward.

 

Thank you, everyone.

In progress, information for posting is below

 

Position Summary:

The Courier supports the TidalHealth Marketing & Communications Department, including the Print Shop, by providing reliable pickup and delivery of materials among TidalHealth hospitals, medical offices, administrative locations and other facilities throughout the Delmarva Peninsula.

 

Education:

  • High School diploma or equivalent required.

 

License and/or certification:

  • Valid Driver’s license is required and insurability under TidalHealth’s automobile insurance plan.

 

Experience:

  • Previous courier, delivery, transportation or customer service experience preferred.
  • Familiarity with the Delmarva Peninsula and TidalHealth service area preferred.

 

Schedule:

  • Primarily day shift.
  • Hours based on departmental needs.
